title: CHAI: Critique-based Human-AI Oversight for Video Captioning
summary: A high-precision video understanding framework that employs a human-in-the-loop critique process to refine AI-generated descriptions. It specializes in cinematic primitives such as camera motion and spatial dynamics, allowing compact models to achieve superior accuracy.
research_notes: Leverages over 200 professional visual primitives; the 8B model variant notably outperforms larger proprietary systems like GPT-5 in specific captioning tasks.

evolution.summary: Building upon the CameraBench (2025) foundation, CHAI introduced a scalable oversight loop and structured cinematic vocabulary. Development is continuing toward Moodio and CameraBench-Pro for professional filmmaking applications.
